drafter.private_reasoning: The client has provided no lease economics or premises area from which to derive a defensible Base Rent amount. Do not invent a rent figure. Advance the discussion with a proposed annual escalation structure, leave the initial amount open for confirmation, clarify that commencement is tied to delivery, and preserve the assignment discussion pending the other side’s review. Do not disclose unrelated confidential information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We propose that Base Rent be stated as a monthly amount in Exhibit A, with annual increases of 3% on each anniversary of the Commencement Date. We have left the initial monthly amount open pending confirmation of the premises area and the parties’ agreed economics. Our proposal is for the Commencement Date to occur upon delivery of the premises to Tenant, with the specific delivery standard and date to be confirmed in the lease. Please send the confirmed Tenant legal name and your client’s proposed Commencement Date when available. We understand you are reviewing the assignment language and will await your position.
